question: What is the value of (3 ÷ 4) of 20 + 16 ÷ 2 - {(1 ÷ 3) of 12 + (2 ÷ 5) of 25}?
solution:
Given:

(3 ÷ 4) of 20 + 16 ÷ 2 - {(1 ÷ 3) of 12 + (2 ÷ 5) of 25}

Formula used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e54636ed411e889d1916f3aa2f06c5b9166f427a3a8425c3cbc9a3f3f9273545.png] 

Calculation:

Using the BODMAS rule,

(3 ÷ 4) of 20 + 16 ÷ 2 - {(1 ÷ 3) of 12 + (2 ÷ 5) of 25}

⇒ 15 + 8 - {4 + 10}

⇒ 10 - 1

⇒ 9

 ∴ The answer is 9.
